args.name: Cultivate meadow roots
args.function: Learn and perform a physically feasible method of cultivating edible meadow roots for a renewable personal food supply.
args.conditions: A meadow-root plant is visible at (10.1,12) in ordinary soil. Its observed stock is six roots. Roots are known to provide 14 nutrition with zero toxicity. Whether harvested roots can propagate, and what preparation or growing conditions are needed, are unknown.
args.inputs: Potentially harvested roots, suitable ground, and any necessary materials identified by review; no tools or planting materials beyond actually acquired inventory are assumed.
args.costs: Unknown; specify feasible learning time, labor, planting inputs, growth time, and maintenance requirements.
args.effects: Enable a real cultivation trial with observable establishment, growth, and eventual harvest if conditions permit. Do not assume propagation succeeds or create immediate food.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"wren\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Develop a general plant-cultivation operation with establishment-trial and maintenance modes. The related-capability search found no cultivation equivalent. Existing probe supports inspection and small tests, and gather transfers accessible stock, but neither establishes or maintains a planted propagule. Reuse those implementations where applicable rather than claiming their functions as new. Propagability and growing requirements remain unverified. The current observed record for start-0-roots reports stock 0 and capacity 6, not six available roots; planting must use an actually available owned input, potentially one of the five recorded roots in item-4-wren-43, subject to its current condition. A renewable harvest cannot yet be promised.\",\"specification\":\"Develop 'Cultivate plants', parameterized by mode, actual plant or propagule reference, accessible plot coordinates, quantity, and any actually supplied amendments or water. Initial executable scope: a hand-planted establishment trial in workable soil, with observation and maintenance; extend the same operation only where supported plant biology permits. No tools, water container, seed, fertilizer, or living bud is granted. References: start-0-roots at (10.1,12), observed revision foundation-forest@1; owned candidate item-4-wren-43, resource root, quantity 5, recorded decay 6.69198518; personal root record establishes nutrition 14 and toxicity 0 only. Revalidate identity, ownership, remaining quantity, decay and reach at execution. The nearby commons-root records are possible visible sources, not owned supplies. Acquiring their produce requires actual travel and gather actions.\\nPrerequisites: independently learned operation, living actor, sufficient energy, one owned whole root or other biologically suitable propagule, and a reachable unoccupied plot whose soil can actually be opened by hand. No eligibility inference from edibility. Inspection may establish that a candidate lacks living regenerative tissue; record that informative failure without asserting that all roots are nonpropagating. Reuse probe (open-baseline:probe:1) for actual inspection or applicable sample tests at its existing costs; consuming a 0.1-unit sample must reduce inventory and cannot silently count as a whole planted root. Reuse gather (base:gather:1, forest.gather) for later collection of exposed ripe output, with its existing one-round duration, 2 energy per unit, stock deduction and range checks. Record these dependencies in implementation metadata.\\nTrial costs and work: reserve one currently available whole candidate per selected plot; one plot per execution. Spend three active rounds and 3 energy total, in checkpointed stages: loosen soil, place input, cover soil. Spend 1 energy per completed stage; movement and inspection are additional existing-action costs. Soft workable soil needs no invented tool. Hard or obstructed ground blocks this version without consumption. Reserve a footprint sufficient for the input and known plant size; do not overlap occupied plants or duplicate plots. At placement atomically subtract the input from its inventory stack and create the tracked planted specimen, retaining its actual mass, condition and provenance. Covering completes planting, not establishment. No food stock is created by these stages.\\nDevelopment handoff must inspect and use the experiment's actual plant and environmental mechanisms. Implement missing propagule viability, rooting, soil moisture and growth state as needed in the existing current-conversation handoff, rather than reject the request because these primitives are absent. A harvested edible root is not automatically viable. If this material cannot establish, the executable trial produces a physically grounded failure; obtaining a viable seed, crown or other propagule is then a prerequisite for another attempt, not a granted inventory item. Do not invent a successful biology or an era-based unlock.\\nOngoing process: planted material experiences elapsed simulation time, actual temperature, light, soil moisture, decay and applicable hazards. Store age, condition, rooting state, accumulated growth and maintenance history. A first observation interval of 10 elapsed rounds and an initial 120-round observation window are trial scheduling parameters, not promised rooting or maturity times; surviving unresolved trials may continue. During development, define executable species-appropriate establishment thresholds, growth duration, environmental tolerances, moisture use and harvest yield from the actual world model before enabling claims of growth or harvest. If that evidence is unavailable, release only the monitored establishment precursor with unresolved outcomes explicitly labelled; do not substitute a timer that manufactures roots. All numeric biological parameters must be recorded in the implemented contract, not improvised by repeated model review. Development and review waiting advance no world time.\\nMaintenance: observation uses probe's actual observation cost of one round and 0.2 energy. Each physical soil-tending execution costs one round and 1 energy, only when a real obstruction or surface condition can be changed by hand. Watering is enabled only with a measured reachable water supply and an actual transfer method; debit the exact transferred quantity from that source or carried inventory and add it to plot moisture, with recorded losses. No periodic water, fertilizer, rain or labor is assumed. Maintenance needs and intervals follow measured conditions and the implemented thresholds, not automatic success after scheduled visits. Leaving a trial alone allows ordinary growth, drying, waterlogging or decay; no offscreen actor performs maintenance.\\nConservation and products: preserve propagule biomass accounting; any new biomass requires modelled photosynthetic energy, water and soil nutrient uptake with explicit source debits or environmental flux accounting. Root stock becomes harvestable only after actual supported development and allocation of biomass, and gather transfers that stock rather than duplicating it. Planting consumes a potential meal; planting itself supplies no nutrition. Mature edible output, if actually produced and verified as the known root resource, retains its ordinary nutrition and toxicity semantics; neither mood nor learning changes nutrition. Failed specimens become only their measured recoverable material or decay products, not fresh food or replacement seed. Harvest that removes the regenerative plant part may end that specimen; renewability requires demonstrated survival/regrowth or another viable propagule and continued real inputs.\\nLifecycle: checkpoint completed stages and charged costs. Interruption pauses active labor; exposed material and living plots continue their ordinary environmental processes during subsequent world ticks. Resume revalidates the same references and remaining requirements, never restarts free progress. Cancel before placement releases surviving reserved inventory once; cancel after placement leaves the real specimen in the plot. Recovery requires an actual reachable removal action and may damage the specimen. Spent time, energy, degraded material and consumed water are never refunded. Actor death stops labor, releases surviving unplaced escrow through ordinary death/inventory rules, and leaves planted specimens subject to normal ecology; no automatic harvesting or ownership transfer. Global simulation pauses freeze all processes. No permissions or consent are inferred for any actor or plot.\",\"learning\":3,\"experienceReview\":\"Three individual study rounds are required after implementation; study, requests, registration, scheduling and interface use alone earn no benefit. Actual observation that verifies establishment, failure, decay or a growing requirement may qualify as information gain, deduplicated by specimen, tested condition and finding rather than action name. Use the existing experience implementation and limits without changing protected accounts, budgets, goals or permissions. Proposed eligibility is at most one modest information-gain event per genuinely new verified finding, with a 10-round cooldown; repeated unchanged checks award none. Familiar successful tending or a real harvest may support modest maintained satisfaction only when personally applicable, with benefit bounded by the existing event cap and subject to existing decay; do not require novelty for legitimate practice. No reward for hoped-for harvests, and no comfort or nutrition from planting. Physical comfort remains capped at 10. Missing experience handlers produce evidence events for development, not direct reward-account writes.\",\"visualReview\":\"Use reusable plot/plant visual metadata: plot footprint, species or unknown identity, planted-material reference, observed stage, visible condition, moisture evidence, progress stage and timestamps. Emit observable events for actual soil preparation, placement, covering, visible emergence, measured growth, wilting, death and harvested stock transfer. Retain provenance and event references so visuals and experience can consume the same verified events without duplicating rewards. Initially show disturbed soil or a planted trial marker, not a mature plant. Hidden viability and unobserved roots are not disclosed by color, labels or metadata exposed to the actor. 'Established', 'growing' and 'harvestable' require their implemented evidence thresholds. Failed or interrupted planting shows its real unfinished or failed state, never a success animation. A user-visible observation deadline is not a growth progress bar.\"}]}"}
